evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no customer concerns were raised because the agenda question was never asked.

top_strength: Jack masterfully anchors and personalizes the estimate, breaking down the 6-hour quote by specific factors (elevator delays, drive time, furniture-only payload) and then immediately de-risks it by explaining how beats flow back to the customer in 15-minute increments — this builds trust in the pricing without any defensive tone.
coaching_note: You never asked 'other than price, what are your biggest concerns?' — the single highest-priority line in the script — which meant no concerns were surfaced, no two-layer discovery happened, and the call jumped straight to logistics; add the agenda question before any probing, and always ask 'does that feel fair?' before closing, then hold silence.
